references.text: Manasse also received towns within the territories of Issachar and Asher, including areas mentioned in the boundary description of Asher's inheritance.
The introduction to the description of the territory of the tribe of Asher, of which verse 25 is a part.
Continuation of the boundary description for the tribe of Asher, with several towns and border areas.
Jacob's blessing over Asher, which prophesied about the fertile land the tribe would inherit.
Moses' blessing over Asher, describing the tribe's prosperity and security in the allotted land.
